extracted.intended_audience: Graduate students in the Department of Philosophy at Western University (especially those with interests in philosophy of science)
extracted.subtask_description: Information about eligibility and expected participation for graduate student membership in the Rotman Institute of Philosophy affiliated with Western University's Philosophy Department.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for membership
rubrics_metrics.description: Graduate students studying in the Department of Philosophy at Western with research interests in philosophy and science (including epistemology, ethics or history of science) are eligible to apply for membership
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicant must be a graduate student in Western's Philosophy Department and have research interests related to philosophy and science; examples of relevant areas include epistemology, ethics of science, or history of science.

rubrics_metrics.name: Participation expectations — talks, conferences, outreach, groups
rubrics_metrics.description: Graduate Student members are expected to participate in Institute sponsored talks, conferences, public outreach events, and reading & working groups
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members should regularly attend and take part in events organized by the Institute, including academic talks and conferences, public-facing outreach activities, and internal reading or working groups.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research involvement and collaboration
rubrics_metrics.description: and to involve themselves in ongoing research projects in cooperation with Institute faculty, postdoctoral fellows, visiting fellows, and graduate students members.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members are expected to engage actively in collaborative research projects alongside Institute-affiliated faculty, postdoctoral researchers, visiting fellows, and other graduate student members.
